source: make a 3d game about clock people vs couchs and I want a giant high detail map and that will be the lobby I also want you to make platforms for which if you step on you teleport to another map and defend your base city that has 200 health also you can pick which difficulty you want to do with nightmare being the hardest and make a summon area on which you spend 100 counts to summon a unit the chances of the units are:common -75% rare-20% epic-3% legendary-0.9% mythic-0.1%

answers.ask: How giant is the lobby — a large plaza you can cross in half a minute, or a town-sized hub?
answers.answer: Make it a town-sized high-detail lobby hub.

answers.ask: Do the couches attack the base in waves you survive, or is it a straight fight between the two sides?
answers.answer: The couches attack the base city in waves, and players defend its 200 health.

answers.ask: Do attackers follow one fixed path to the base, or come from anywhere across open ground?
answers.answer: Use one fixed path leading to the base city so the defense gameplay is clear and playable.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map with a town-sized, high-detail lobby hub themed around clock people versus couches. Arrange teleport platforms around the hub as gateways to separate maps. Include a summon area within the lobby. One destination is a base-defense city: a defended city base sits at the end of a single clear approach path, with open ground along the route for incoming couch attackers and defensive placement around the city.
